summary.text: Jonathan Sickler is a Republican state senator from District 17 in Grand Forks who took office in June 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a lawyer and chief legal officer of AE2S, an engineering consulting firm.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Sickler earned a B.A. from the University of North Dakota in 1999 and a J.D. from Harvard Law School in 2002.
His career has included work as a lawyer and as chief legal officer of AE2S, an engineering consulting firm.
Sickler assumed office on June 2, 2022, succeeding Ray Holmberg, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
He faces Democrat Katie Benton in the general election.
His 2025 assignments include the Appropriations Committee and its Government Operations Division, and he chairs the interim Higher Education Institutions Committee.
His legislative biography lists him as married with three children.
